goal: Prevent inbound Tor peers from being misclassified as local network connections
Stop anonymous Tor traffic from inheriting address-based whitelist permissions
agreement: Broad support for preventing Tor peers from inheriting local whitelist permissions
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog)
Startup failure objections resolved by disabling Tor listening with a warning (sedited, mzumsande)
Open suggestion to bundle dedicated bind addresses with onion service settings (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because inbound Tor traffic routed to normal binds can inherit local whitelist permissions
It protects node operators using explicit binds and whitelist rules from unintended access
